rule: Reuse existing CNS objects when semantics match. Create a new first-class object only when the recovered contract expresses information that cannot be represented honestly without it.

sources.title: 4PLANET BRAIN EVALUATION, CONTRADICTION & FAILURE MEMORY SPEC v0.1

mappings.note: Preserves inputs; detection does not resolve truth.

mappings.cns: source freshness + Doctor SOURCE_STALE/SOURCE_DEGRADED + context TTL/revision drift
mappings.gap: Affected downstream scope/review owner/review_due are not yet first-class staleness records.
Root cause, why-not-caught-earlier, fix IDs, regression-test IDs and recurrence lifecycle are not yet one durable failure object.
Exact question, reversible/consequence/urgency and evidence-at-decision snapshot could be strengthened.
Material assumptions are not independently addressable/versioned objects.
Resolution date, calibrated probability and prediction→outcome linkage are not first-class.
Non-code experiments need a generic experiment contract rather than code-worktree semantics.
Baseline/expected/actual/unit/confounders/unexpected effects are not all typed columns.
Decision quality, execution quality, outcome quality and causal confidence are not separately typed yet.
Applicability/non-applicability and affected claims/models/rules should be explicit relations.
If predictive models become first-class later, add model-specific version lineage then; do not create it prematurely.
Durable approved rule identity/version/review date is not yet a dedicated object.
